date: 2026-08-02

I've been poking at a 6-layer transformer. Attention entropy
collapses hard after layer 4.

## The measurement

Standard Shannon entropy over each head's attention distribution:

$$H_h = -\sum_i p_i \log p_i$$

::: {#cell-fig-entropy .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code code-fold="true"}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.hist(np.random.beta(2, 5, 1000) * 4, bins=40, color="#b04a24")
plt.xlabel("entropy (nats)")
plt.show()
```
